card.name: Start of overdose treatment instructions
card.fires_on: Small words or commas right after an opening treatment phrase in overdose sections, such as "For general management", "establish and maintain", or "treatment include". It fires just before the first supportive-care step is named.

modes.label: Comma after general management
modes.description: The comma following "For general management" in poisoning treatment text, before lavage is mentioned.
modes.example: For general management<<,>> gastric and rectal lavage with sodium

modes.label: Article or verb before airway or fluids
modes.description: A small word or verb inside "establish and maintain an airway" or "principles of treatment include the".
modes.example: Establish and maintain<< an>> airway to ensure adequate ventilation and oxygen

card.writes: It seems to push toward naming the first supportive-care step, such as continuing or maintaining care, though the listed tokens are noisy.
card.plain: It marks the spot in an overdose section where general supportive treatment steps are about to be listed.
